record.title: Asymptotic proportion of components in random meandric systems
record.statement:
For each $n\ge 1$, let $X_n$ be the number of components of a uniformly random meandric system on $2n$ points; equivalently, $X_n$ is the random variable on $NC_2(2n)^2$ that assigns to a pair of non-crossing pairings the number of components of the resulting meandric system. We conjecture that
\[
\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{\mathbb{E}(X_n)}{n}
\]
exists.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16636), page 53. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Mahler’s conjecture for convex bodies
record.statement:
For every convex body $K\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$, define
\[
\bar s(K)=|K|\,\inf_{x\in K}|(K-x)^\circ|.
\]
Mahler’s conjecture asserts that
\[
\bar s(K)\ge \frac{(n+1)^{n+1}}{(n!)^2},
\]
with equality for the simplex $\Delta^n$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/54](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16637), page 10. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Gardner–Zvavitch conjecture for symmetric convex sets
record.statement:
For every dimension $n\ge 1$, every pair of origin-symmetric convex sets $K,L\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$, and every $\lambda\in[0,1]$, the standard Gaussian measure $\gamma$ satisfies
\[
\gamma\bigl(\lambda K+(1-\lambda)L\bigr)^{1/n}
\geq
\lambda\,\gamma(K)^{1/n}+(1-\lambda)\,\gamma(L)^{1/n}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/54](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16637), page 30. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Surface-area analogue of the Busemann–Petty problem
record.statement:
Suppose that origin-symmetric convex bodies $K,L\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ satisfy
\[
\operatorname{vol}_{n-2}(\partial K\cap a^\perp)\le \operatorname{vol}_{n-2}(\partial L\cap a^\perp)
\quad\text{for all }a\in S^{n-1}.
\]
Does it follow that
\[
\operatorname{vol}_{n-1}(\partial K)\le \operatorname{vol}_{n-1}(\partial L)?
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/54](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16637), page 33. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Gaussian multi-bubble conjecture for $3\le q\le n+1$
record.statement: For $q\ge 3$ with $q\le n+1$, the configuration minimizing the Gaussian interface area among decompositions of $\mathbb{R}^n$ into $q$ sets of prescribed Gaussian measure is given by the Voronoi cells of $q$ equidistant points. The report states that this conjecture is confirmed for all $3\le q\le n+1$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/54](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16637), page 43. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: A strengthened form of Ryabogin’s congruent-sections theorem in dimensions $n\ge 4$
record.statement:
Let $n\ge 4$, and let $f,g:S^{n-1}\to\mathbb R$ be continuous. Suppose that for every $u\in S^{n-1}$ there exists an orthogonal map $T_u:u^\perp\to u^\perp$, required not to be idempotent, such that
$$
f(x)=g(T_u x)\quad\text{for all }x\in S^{n-1}\cap u^\perp.
$$
Must it follow that either $f(x)=g(x)$ for all $x\in S^{n-1}$ or $f(x)=g(-x)$ for all $x\in S^{n-1}$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/54](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16637), page 53. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Alperin–McKay conjecture for special linear and unitary groups
record.statement:
Let $G=\operatorname{SL}_n(\varepsilon q)$, where $q$ is a prime power and $\varepsilon\in\{\pm1\}$, with $\operatorname{SL}_n(-q)=\operatorname{SU}_n(q)$. If $\ell$ is a prime satisfying $\ell\nmid 3q(q-\varepsilon)$, then for every $\ell$-block $B$ of $G$ with defect group $D$, and its Brauer correspondent $b$ in $N_G(D)$, one has
$$|\operatorname{Irr}_0(B)|=|\operatorname{Irr}_0(b)|.$$

record.title: Conjecture on the 2-parts of real conjugacy-class sizes
record.statement: Let $G$ be a finite group. Suppose that all non-central real class sizes of $G$ have the same $2$-part; equivalently, $|x^G|_2=2^a$ for all non-central real elements $x\in G$, where $a\ge 0$ is fixed. Then $G$ has $2$-length one: there exist normal subgroups $N\le K\le G$ such that $N$ and $G/K$ have odd order and $K/N$ is a $2$-group.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16776), page 46. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Upper-tail probability for triangle counts in sparse random graphs
record.statement:
Let $X$ be the number of triangles in $G_{n,p}$. For fixed $\delta>0$, define
$$
\Phi_X(\delta)=\min\{e(G)\log(1/p):G\subseteq K_n\text{ and }\mathbb{E}[X\mid G\subseteq G_{n,p}]\ge (1+\delta)\mathbb{E}[X]\}.
$$
Then, for every $p=p(n)$ satisfying $n^{-1}\log n\ll p\ll 1$,
$$
-\log\Pr\bigl(X\ge (1+\delta)\mathbb{E}[X]\bigr)=(1\pm o(1))\,\Phi_X(\delta).
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16931), page 43. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Decomposition of the complete graph into bounded-degree regular graphs
record.statement: For all \(\Delta \in \mathbb{N}\), there exists an \(n_0 \in \mathbb{N}\) such that the following holds for all \(n \ge n_0\). Let \(F_1, \ldots, F_t\) be \(n\)-vertex graphs such that \(F_i\) is \(r_i\)-regular for some \(r_i \le \Delta\) and \(\sum_{i\in[t]} r_i = n-1\). Then there is a decomposition of \(K_n\) into \(F_1, \ldots, F_t\).

record.statement: Let $H_1,H_2$ be graphs, and let $\delta_{H_1,H_2}(\varepsilon)$ denote the maximal $\delta\in(0,1)$ such that every graph that is $\delta$-close to being induced $H_i$-free for each $i=1,2$ is $\varepsilon$-close to being induced $\{H_1,H_2}$-free. Is it true that for every $a>0$ there are graphs $H_1,H_2$ for which $\delta_{H_1,H_2}(\varepsilon)\le O(\varepsilon^a)$?

Study the giant component problem for $G^f_{n,m}$ or $G^{f,*}_{n,m}$ when $f$ is \27truly\27 non-linear, in contrast to the approximately linear case (a polynomial of degree at most one in $k$).

record.title: Vorst’s conjecture
record.statement:
Assume all rings are unital and commutative. A ring $A$ is called $K_n$-regular if, for every positive integer $m$, the canonical map
$$K_n(A)\longrightarrow K_n\bigl(A[X_1,\ldots,X_m]\bigr)$$
is an isomorphism. Let $A$ be an algebra essentially of finite type over a field $k$, and let $d=\dim(A)$. If $A$ is $K_{d+1}$-regular, must $A$ be regular?

record.title: Multiplicity formula for supercuspidal representations of spherical pairs
record.statement:
For a general spherical pair $(G,H)$ over a local field $F$ and a character $\chi:H(F)\to\mathbb{C}^{\times}$, the multiplicity formula
$$m(\pi,\chi)=m_{\mathrm{geom}}(\pi,\chi)$$
should hold for every supercuspidal irreducible smooth representation $\pi$ of $G(F)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17140), page 57. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Schwartz-space characterization for the basic affine space
record.statement:
Conjecture: The space $S(X)$ coincides with
$$\widetilde{S}(X)=\{f\in L^2(X)\mid \Phi_w(f)\text{ has bounded support for all }w\in W\}.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17140), page 69. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Observables in scaling limits of unitary minimal models
record.statement: **Conjecture.** For every unitary minimal model $M(k+2,k+1)$ with $k\ge 3$, the observables in the corresponding scaling limit contain subsets corresponding to smeared-field observables $\phi(f)$, bounded observables of a local conformal net (LCN), and observables in the corresponding VOA $M(k+2,k+1)$, analogously to the asserted result for the Ising model $M(4,3)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/49](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17292), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Gilbreath's conjecture on iterated prime differences
record.statement:
Let $p_1=2,p_2=3,
\ldots$ be the primes. Set $a^{(1)}_i=p_i$ and, recursively, $a^{(r+1)}_i=\lvert a^{(r)}_{i+1}-a^{(r)}_i\rvert$. Is it true that $a^{(r)}_1=1$ for every row $r\ge 2$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/50](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17293), page 39. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Green’s covering problem for prime-modulus residue classes
record.statement:
We are interested in positive integers up to $X$, and set $H=X^{\theta}$, where $\theta$ is slightly greater than $1/2$, say $\theta=0.51$. Put $I=[H,2H]$. For each prime $p\in I$, choose a residue class $a_p$. Set
\[
K=[1,X]\cap\bigcup_{p\in I}a_p.
\]
Is it always true that $\operatorname{card}K\gg X^{1-\varepsilon}$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/50](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17293), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
